Police_Power: Stop a vehicle and require production of driving licence/insurance
Threshold: None beyond driving on a road; officer in uniform for s.55
Key_Limits: Detention limited to document production; non-uniformed officer must identify (RTA s.123)

Police_Power: Erect roadblocks and stop all traffic
Threshold: Officer considers it necessary (s.26); written Inspector+ authority (s.78)
Key_Limits: Does not authorise searches of particular vehicles

Police_Power: Arrest without warrant for a seizable offence on reasonable suspicion
Threshold: Reasonable complaint / credible information / reasonable suspicion
Key_Limits: Grounds stated (s.28A(1)); 24h rule; seizable offences only

Police_Power: Search a vehicle without warrant
Threshold: Reasonable grounds for suspecting use in an offence
Key_Limits: Only as long as reasonably necessary; 48h removal limit (s.24(4))

Police_Power: Search an arrested person and take belongings into safe custody
Threshold: Arrest; reasonable suspicion for pat-down
Key_Limits: Fourth Schedule procedure; same sex; list of items

Police_Power: Orally examine any person acquainted with the case and record a statement
Threshold: Investigation in progress
Key_Limits: Must give s.112(4) information; self-incrimination proviso; s.113 limits use

Police_Power: Require attendance of a witness by written order
Threshold: Investigation; person appears acquainted with the case
Key_Limits: Refusal -> Magistrate's warrant, not arrest

Police_Power: Detain for investigation up to 24 hours
Threshold: Lawful arrest; reasonable period
Key_Limits: Magistrate's order required beyond 24h

Police_Power: Apply for remand
Threshold: Investigation cannot be completed; accusation well founded
Key_Limits: Caps 4+3 / 7+7; accused heard; reasons recorded

Police_Power: Search premises under a Magistrate's warrant
Source: CPC s.56 (also s.54); DDA s.27(1); CCA s.10(1)
Threshold: Magistrate's reason to believe evidence is in the place
Key_Limits: Scope (s.55); produce warrant (s.59); occupant present; list (s.64-65)

Police_Power: Search premises without warrant where delay would frustrate the search
Source: CPC s.116, s.116A; DDA s.27(4); CCA s.10(2); MACC s.31(3); AMLA s.31
Threshold: Rank requirements (Inspector/Sub-Inspector) + reasonable cause + delay risk
Key_Limits: Same safeguards as warrant searches 'so far as may be' (s.116(4))

Police_Power: Detain and search persons found in a place being lawfully searched
Threshold: Lawful place search; thing concealable on the person
Key_Limits: Inspector+ presence (s.17); same sex; only until search completed

Police_Power: Access computerised data, including by being given passwords, during a search
Threshold: Inspector+ conducting a search under the Code
Key_Limits: Compulsion of suspects and biometrics unsettled

Police_Power: Seize and detain property as evidence
Source: CPC s.20, s.56, s.64; AMLA s.45; MACC s.31; DDA s.31(3)
Threshold: Reason to believe evidence/instrument
Key_Limits: Signed list; copy on request; return when no longer needed

Police_Power: Enter premises (forcibly if needed) to arrest a person believed inside
Threshold: Warrant or s.23 ground + reason to believe person inside
Key_Limits: Notify authority and purpose and demand admittance first

Police_Power: Use all means necessary to effect an arrest if resisted
Threshold: Resistance or evasion
Key_Limits: No right to cause death unless offence punishable with death/life; no more restraint than needed (s.19(1))

Police_Power: Require an arrested DDA suspect to give a urine specimen / medical examination
Threshold: Arrest on DDA charge; reasonable grounds; Sergeant+
Key_Limits: Medical officer preferred; refusal offence s.31A(1B)

Police_Power: Arrest for refusing name and address (non-seizable offence in presence; roadblock; licence stop)
Threshold: Offence in presence + refusal/false particulars
Key_Limits: Release on bond once identity ascertained

Police_Power: Intercept communications
Source: CPC s.116C; SOSMA s.6; MACC s.43
Threshold: Public Prosecutor's authorisation (written or reduced to writing)
Key_Limits: Court takes cognizance; admissible at trial

Police_Power: Arrest and detain for security offences up to 24h + 28 days without judicial order
Threshold: Reason to believe involvement in a First Schedule security offence; Superintendent+ for extension
Key_Limits: Not for political belief (s.4(3)); next-of-kin immediately; lawyer within 48h; Art 5(2) habeas corpus remains
